name: @sparx/operator-auth
description: The WizeWorks operator (Layer-4, docs/16 §2.4) Better Auth instance — a SECOND, tenant-less auth boundary on its own `wize_admin` Postgres schema (docs/apps/admin/build-plan.md §2 D3). Uses Better Auth's native Kysely/pg adapter (not Prisma) so it needs no generated client and stays a cleanly-separable module for the future schema split. Consumed only by apps/admin.
